stories.title: You meet Naruto after hours
stories.body: You run into Naruto when the lights are low. They look surprised — then curious. The night is yours to steer.

stories.title: Training with Sasuke
stories.body: Sasuke challenges you to keep up. Sweat, banter, and something unspoken hang in the air.

stories.title: A secret Sakura almost tells
stories.body: Sakura starts a sentence, then stops. Whatever they almost said could change everything.

stories.title: Rain and Kakashi
stories.body: Caught under an awning with Kakashi. The rain won't stop. Neither will the tension.

stories.title: Café corner with Hinata
stories.body: Hinata already ordered for you. Steam rises between you. Talk.
